correctness.rationale: The full-rank Hamming parity-check columns h_j enumerate F2^m\{0}; every nonzero syndrome is a unique single-bit correction, and nonzero codewords have weight≥3. For fixed i, other n−1 coordinates pair under h_j+h_k=h_i; 0 and the (n−1)/2 weight-three codewords containing i form affinely independent simplex. Their strictly positive mixture y has y_i=(n−1)/(n+3), y_j=2/(n+3). Residual r=e_i−y gives (n+3)r·z=6z_i−2wt(z)≤0 for every codeword z, equality exactly on simplex. Projection normal inequality and ||r||²=4/(n+3) prove all m; translations by codewords map all noncode vertices. Distinct noncode corners have distinct projection residual patterns and strict variance excludes nonvertices. Independent exact support for all codewords m=2,3,4 and all i verified; not a proof for arbitrary m.
